execution_principle: Archive one bounded primary trajectory that preserves management guidance, contractual schedule, project-state revisions and later outcome as distinct semantic roles. SEC retrieval of an Albemarle-authored disclosure is retrieval provenance, not independent corroboration. Do not collapse construction completion, successful commissioning, qualification, first product, commercial production or sales into one production date.

source_identity.authority_note: Albemarle remains the publisher/claim authority for its releases and filings; SEC is the retrieval/filing transport. The 2019 contract schedule is primary contractual language filed by Albemarle and must be labeled contract_schedule, not management_guidance.

target_claim_anchors: Kemerton earthworks had begun and management said the site was on track with projections.
The project was described as 60,000 metric tons initial lithium-hydroxide capacity with expansion ability to 100,000 metric tons over time.
Commissioning was expected to start in stages during 2021.
required_vintages.capacity_scope: project-level public management description before later contractual descoping detail
required_vintages.next_action: archive exact investor-release bytes and ground launch/capacity/commissioning excerpts

target_claim_anchors: Train 1 and Train 2 were each defined as initially 20,000 tpa and expected 25,000 tpa after a debottlenecking project.

The buyer was required to use reasonable endeavours to complete construction and successful Commissioning by 18 March 2021 for Train 1 and 25 July 2021 for Train 2, or as soon as reasonably possible afterward.
The agreement describes a descoping from three lithium-hydroxide processing trains to Train 1 and Train 2 and a 60/40 ownership context.
required_vintages.capacity_scope: two contract-defined trains: 40kt initial, 50kt after debottlenecking; do not overwrite the January 2019 project-level 60kt public description
required_vintages.next_action: archive exact SEC exhibit and ground contract-defined capacity, dates, descoping and ownership fragments separately from management guidance

required_vintages.target_claim_anchor: Construction of Kemerton and La Negra was expected to be completed by the end of 2021, with sales volume from these plants beginning in 2022.
required_vintages.next_action: archive exact 10-K and ground the Kemerton construction-completion and sales-volume guidance without importing later startup knowledge

target_claim_anchors: Kemerton I remained on track for construction completion later in 2021.
Labor shortages and COVID-19 travel restrictions led the company to prioritize Kemerton I and move Kemerton II construction completion to the end of 2022Q1.
Kemerton I and II were expected to reach commercial production in 2022 after an approximately six-month commissioning and qualification period.
expectation_horizon: Kemerton II construction completion by 2022Q1 end
commercial production during 2022 after ~6 month commissioning and qualification
required_vintages.explicit_revision_cause: labor shortages and COVID-19 travel restrictions in Western Australia
required_vintages.next_action: archive exact EX-99.1 and preserve revision cause plus commissioning/qualification period separately from construction completion

target_claim_anchors: Kemerton I was mechanically complete and in the commissioning phase.
Kemerton II remained under construction with the construction team dedicated to it.
required_vintages.project_state_semantics: mechanical completion is an achieved state; commissioning is subsequent and must not be collapsed into commercial production or qualification
required_vintages.next_action: archive exact EX-99.1 and ground mechanical-complete versus commissioning state

target_claim_anchors: Kemerton I remained in commissioning and was expected to achieve first product in May 2022.
Kemerton II remained on track for mechanical completion in the second half of 2022.
required_vintages.next_action: archive exact EX-99.1 and ground first-product expectation distinctly from commercial production/qualification
